description: Unit tests for TrustStoreNSS component in Chromium, testing trust and distrust of certificates, trust store behaviors, and slot filtering logic.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestBase
classes.description: Base class for TrustStoreNSS unit tests, providing setup, utility methods, and trust verification logic.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestWithSlotFilterType
classes.description: Parameterized test class for TrustStoreNSS with different slot filter types and system trust settings.

classes.name: DebugData
classes.description: Helper class for storing user data during trust evaluation tests.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestIgnoreSystemCerts
classes.description: Test class for TrustStoreNSS behavior when ignoring system trust settings.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestWithoutSlotFilter
classes.description: Test class for TrustStoreNSS without slot filtering, testing trust of various certificate types.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestDoNotAllowUserSlots
classes.description: Test class for TrustStoreNSS configured to disallow trusting certificates on user slots.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestAllowSpecifiedUserSlot
classes.description: Test class for TrustStoreNSS configured to trust only specific user slots.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for testing CertIssuerSource with TrustStoreNSS, managing NSS database and certificates.

methods.name: SystemTrustSettingToString
methods.description: Converts TrustStoreNSS::SystemTrustSetting enum to string for test naming.

methods.name: TrustTypeToNSSTrust
methods.description: Maps CertificateTrustType to NSS trust flags.

methods.name: GetASSLTrustedBuiltinRoot
methods.description: Retrieves a trusted root certificate from NSS built-in roots.

methods.name: GetNSSTrustForCert
methods.description: Retrieves NSS trust flags for a given certificate.

methods.name: CreateTrustStoreNSS
methods.description: Factory method to create TrustStoreNSS instances with specific configurations.

methods.name: AddCertToNSSSlot
methods.description: Adds a certificate to an NSS slot.

methods.name: AddCertToNSSSlotWithTrust
methods.description: Adds a certificate to NSS slot and sets trust.

methods.name: AddCertsToNSS
methods.description: Adds predefined set of certificates to NSS database for testing.

methods.name: TrustCert
methods.description: Marks a certificate as trusted in NSS.

methods.name: TrustServerCert
methods.description: Marks a certificate as trusted as a server.

methods.name: TrustCaAndServerCert
methods.description: Marks a certificate as trusted both as CA and server.

methods.name: ChangeCertTrust
methods.description: Changes trust flags for a certificate.

methods.name: ChangeCertTrustInSlot
methods.description: Changes trust flags for a certificate in a specific NSS slot.

methods.name: TrustStoreContains
methods.description: Checks if trust store contains expected trust for a certificate.

methods.name: GetCertString
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for a certificate for debugging.

methods.name: HasTrust
methods.description: Verifies if certificates have expected trust.
